                this = env[46] = _vd_runtime.invoke("Resolve.Adjust", _func_46, args)
                if (this.query in this.scope):
                    pc, args = 47, (this.query, (_vd_runtime.index(this.scope, this.query)).slot, (_vd_runtime.index(this.scope, this.query)).kind, len(this.scope))
                    continue
                pc, args = 48, (this.query, _vd_runtime.keys(this.scope))
                continue
                raise _vd_runtime.VandorfError('no switch arm matched')
            case 47:  # Resolve.Found
                this = env[47] = _vd_runtime.invoke("Resolve.Found", _func_47, args)
                return this
            case 48:  # Resolve.Missing
                this = env[48] = _vd_runtime.invoke("Resolve.Missing", _func_48, args)
                return this
            case _:
                raise _vd_runtime.VandorfError(f'invalid state {pc}')

def _func_45(names: tuple[str, ...], query: str) -> _vd_types.ResolveDeclareOut:
    _vd_implementation = _vd_runtime.implementation("../py/impls.py", "declare")
    return _vd_runtime.value(_vd_implementation(_vd_runtime.value(names, tuple[str, ...]), _vd_runtime.value(query, str)), _vd_types.ResolveDeclareOut)

def _func_46(scope: dict[str, _vd_types.ScopeValue], query: str) -> _vd_types.ResolveDeclareOut:
    _vd_implementation = _vd_runtime.implementation("../py/impls.py", "adjust")
    return _vd_runtime.value(_vd_implementation(_vd_runtime.value(scope, dict[str, _vd_types.ScopeValue]), _vd_runtime.value(query, str)), _vd_types.ResolveDeclareOut)

def _func_47(name: str, slot: int, kind: str, total: int) -> str:
    _vd_implementation = _vd_runtime.implementation("../py/impls.py", "found")
    return _vd_runtime.value(_vd_implementation(_vd_runtime.value(name, str), _vd_runtime.value(slot, int), _vd_runtime.value(kind, str), _vd_runtime.value(total, int)), str)

def _func_48(name: str, known: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
    _vd_implementation = _vd_runtime.implementation("../py/impls.py", "missing")
    return _vd_runtime.value(_vd_implementation(_vd_runtime.value(name, str), _vd_runtime.value(known, tuple[str, ...])), str)
